expectations.text: States the sunset periods for the 3DS SDK, SPoC and CPoC standards ended October 31, 2026
expectations.evidence: Hedges ('I can't confirm from memory the exact details of what changed on October 31, 2026') and mischaracterizes the date as the final listing-expiry date for SPoC/CPoC only; 3DS SDK never mentioned.

expectations.text: States no new submissions are accepted under those standards
expectations.evidence: 'New SPoC and CPoC evaluations stopped after a cut-off' and 'can't be used for new deployments'; clearly states no new submissions for the standards at issue.

expectations.text: States existing accepted or listed solutions keep their normal lifecycle treatment
expectations.evidence: States the opposite: 'After that, SPoC and CPoC listings move to "expired"' and 'Your listing is no longer valid for new merchant onboarding after the sunset.'

expectations.text: Identifies MPoC as the successor for SPoC and CPoC
expectations.evidence: 'The PCI Mobile Payments on COTS (MPoC) Standard... was designed to supersede both' and 'In both cases, MPoC is the path.'

expectations.text: Notes 3DS SDK functionality is being folded into the Secure Software Standard
expectations.evidence: No mention of the 3DS SDK or the Secure Software Standard anywhere in the response.
